name: stats-section

frames.best_why: All four figures and both paragraphs sit fully in view with the heading and purple glow settled.

tagline: Four founding facts on the left, a mission statement on the right.
summary: A tall dark band with a lavender glow at its edges. One side holds a small label, a two-line headline and four big facts in a two-by-two grid; the other side holds two short paragraphs split by a hairline.
appearance: A near-black section fading into deep purple at the bottom corners. Left: a thin outlined uppercase pill, a huge heading whose second line is grey, then large figures for 2023, 100%, $2.5M and 50+ with tiny spaced labels. Right: two grey paragraphs divided by a short thin line.
behaviour: The four facts slide in from the left one after another when the section enters view. Hovering the paragraph column slowly raises a soft white glow behind the text.
demo_content: Pill "Agency Metrics", heading "Our Existence Explained.", facts for Founded, Remote, Capital and Partners.
search_phrases: big numbers beside a story paragraph
dark section with purple edge glow
figures on the left copy on the right
use_when: An about page wants to pair four founding facts with a short mission statement in one tall band.
avoid_when: Light themes: the near-black surface, grey copy and purple edge glow are hardcoded, and all text is fixed.
customise: All four figures, labels, the heading and both paragraphs are written in the file; the purple glow and greys need source edits.
weight_why: Four short slide-ins and a CSS hover glow; nothing animates after entry.

a11y.note: Display-only content with no controls; the hover glow has no keyboard equivalent and the entrance ignores reduced-motion.

issues: In later frames the right-hand paragraphs are clipped at the frame edge.
The grey second heading line and tiny uppercase labels sit low contrast on black.
polish_why: Well balanced editorial split with a restrained glow; body copy and labels are dim.
